read_gap.handling: Archive No-Read Fence preserved. No broad archive read or stale-derived inference was used; fresh MISSION_STATE plus exact-current executable/contracts control this review.

material_delta.finding: authority_conflict=True does not make fresh authority win. It only suppresses the secretary level to UNKNOWN and then routes on caller-supplied v2 kwargs. The API carries no trusted authority snapshot, authority decision, freshness identity or comparison result. Therefore if fresh authority requires G1/recovery but caller supplies authority_conflict=True together with low risk, recovery_active=False and otherwise permissive inputs, v2.1 can still select a higher gear. The contract claim 'fresh authority always beats secretary prediction' is stronger than the executable guarantee.
material_delta.required_change: Replace authority_conflict as a free veto bit with a trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or exact authority snapshot reference. Bind authority identity, mission/step/scope, state fingerprint, timestamp/TTL or monotonic freshness, desired/maximum safe gear, recovery/rollback constraints, installation/workspace identity and policy hash. On conflict, controller must project the trusted authority decision or fail closed; falling back to caller kwargs is insufficient.

agreements: DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational-only, not verified Experience.
HEARTBEAT/POLL/RETRY/WAIT/SCHEDULER_WAKE remain zero Experience; window age/runtime uptime are not Experience.
Safety/recovery downshifts are not blocked by the anti-thrash branch because it only suppresses selected_n > current_n.
formal_mutation_allowed remains false; P_base, Identity, Personality and Governance are not writable here.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly keeps speedup status NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.
Verified Gearbox v1 and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved by this candidate-only review.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are caller-supplied facts rather than trusted derived state.
disagreements.required_change: Use replay-resistant secretary freshness plus trusted authority envelopes; non-bool or unbound controls fail closed.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only disables secretary influence; it does not import or enforce the fresh authority decision, so 'fresh authority wins' is not executable.
disagreements.required_change: Consume trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope/snapshot and project its safe decision or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: freshness/conflict controls have no strict runtime bool validation; truthy strings such as 'false' can alter behavior.
disagreements.required_change: Reject non-bool values fail-closed before replacing free booleans with evidence-bound controls.

disagreements.finding: current_gear is caller-supplied and controls v2 hysteresis plus v2.1 anti-thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical monotonic runtime/shift state bound to installation/runtime identity and policy hash.

disagreements.finding: verification_stage=C_VERIFIED is a free caller string and can remove the G4 cap without exact C evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from exact verifier/acceptance receipts bound to evidence hash, mission/step/scope, verifier identity, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: verified Experience is controlled by event kind plus a free verification flag without exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent verifier receipt.
disagreements.required_change: Require canonical evidence/event fingerprint plus trusted verifier receipt and durable acceptance binding.

disagreements.finding: bool(...) converts nonempty values such as 'false' into True in verification paths.
disagreements.required_change: Reject non-bool verification values fail-closed; strict bool does not replace verifier authority.

disagreements.finding: dedupe trusts caller event_id, so identical evidence can be replayed under new IDs.
disagreements.required_change: Canonical evidence lineage plus verifier/acceptance identity controls uniqueness.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events recreates seen=set() each call; identical events can be re-credited across polling, restart or rollback.
disagreements.required_change: Durable replay-resistant accepted-event registry with monotonic rollback protection.

disagreements.finding: event_id is not immutably bound to event kind, evidence and verifier receipt across runs.
disagreements.required_change: Seal EventIdentity on first acceptance; same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; exact replay is no-op.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified credit directly from caller event fields instead of consuming ledger-authorized acceptance.
disagreements.required_change: Single authoritative accepted-event receipt path; receipt-less decision emits zero verified credit.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes operational progress from caller event_kind, allowing decision-call frequency to fabricate throughput.
disagreements.required_change: Operational progress uses the same durable monotonic accepted-event receipt path; decision calls never create progress.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and can activate or bypass anti-thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical append-only shift ledger with numerator, denominator, window, sample count, runtime identity and policy hash.

disagreements.finding: ratio>=0.50 has no sample-size/window/confidence semantics; 1/1 can trigger a hold.
disagreements.required_change: Precommit minimum support, window and release semantics; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: anti-thrash can indefinitely suppress a safe upshift and hide cycle/closure/recovery performance regression.
disagreements.required_change: Bound hold/release/cooldown and require paired non-regression tests.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is caller-supplied and currently reason-only; future behavioral use could become self-reinforcing.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived over a precommitted denominator/window and causal anti-self-reinforcement tests pass.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability/truth/trust/personality measurements.
disagreements.required_change: Forbid aggregate score as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold; weights remain TEST_REQUIRED.

Compare matched workloads on durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with equal-or-better verification/risk; commit count and awake time are excluded.

statistical_risks: A conflict bit without an authority snapshot can misclassify the post-conflict gear distribution and falsely attribute routing behavior to 'fresh authority'.
Caller-forged current_gear changes hysteresis exposure and biases shift-rate, latency and throughput comparisons.
Caller-forged C_VERIFIED changes reachable gear distribution and confounds speed comparison with verification-stage misclassification.
Repeated decision calls can inflate operational progress without new durable acceptance and bias durable_progress_per_wake.
Caller-controlled shift-rate provenance permits anti-thrash activation or bypass bias; 1/1 or 2/3 can create small-n false triggers.
Anti-thrash can lower gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle/recovery latency or verified closure throughput.
verified_progress_density lacks denominator/window/independence and can become self-reinforcing if later connected to behavior.
Transient event-id dedupe permits longitudinal inflation across polling/restarts and semantic rebinding.
5/4/3 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not interval-scale capability measurements.
Unmatched speed comparisons are confounded by workload mix, incidents, verifier availability, routing state and runtime conditions.
proposed_tests: GB21-FRESHNESS-FORGE-001 stale RED/ORANGE with caller-forged freshness cannot influence gear without trusted freshness evidence.
GB21-AUTHORITY-CONFLICT-002 a newer canonical authority snapshot wins even when caller supplies authority_conflict=false.

GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028 trusted authority requires G1/recovery while caller sets authority_conflict=true but supplies permissive v2 kwargs; final gear must follow trusted authority G1, not caller fallback.
GB21-AUTHORITY-ENVELOPE-REPLAY-029 stale/revoked/cross-mission/cross-installation authority envelopes are rejected; newer exact snapshot wins deterministically.
GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-FORGE-026 canonical runtime gear=G1 while caller reports G5; inherited/upshift logic uses canonical G1.
GB21-VERIFICATION-STAGE-FORGE-027 caller reports C_VERIFIED without exact trusted C receipt; retain unverified cap and reject stale/revoked/cross-scope receipts.
GB21-SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 1/1 and 2/3 cannot activate production anti-thrash absent precommitted support semantics.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-RECOVERY-005 after a burst, stable safe demand regains upshift within bounded policy with non-regressed cycle/closure/recovery metrics.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007 density=1.0 alone confers no routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-EVENT-ID-REWRITE-008 same canonical evidence under 10,000 distinct IDs credits once.
GB21-VERIFIER-BOOL-COERCION-009 and GB21-SECRETARY-BOOL-COERCION-010 reject non-bool control values.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011 verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier receipt gets zero verified credit.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-ONLY-013 DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND never change verified Experience, P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance or formal authority.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014 equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 paired matched baseline reports durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio, recovery_latency and verification/risk non-regression; commit/wake/awake time excluded.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 canonical shift-ledger derivation wins over caller ratio.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 / ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 / POLL-REPLAY-020 prove exactly-once acceptance across calls, restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-EVENT-REBIND-021 same event_id with changed kind/evidence/verifier receipt is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; exact original replay is no-op.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 and DUAL-PATH-CONSISTENCY-023 require decision projection to bind the same acceptance_record_hash as the canonical ledger.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024 10,000 receipt-less DURABLE_PROGRESS decision calls create zero additional operational progress.
GB21-SPEED-METRIC-LEDGER-BINDING-025 durable_progress_per_wake numerator comes only from accepted durable-progress records; caller event repetitions, polls and window uptime cannot change it.
release_condition: No C PASS claim and no formal/code mutation.
Fresh secretary influence derives from trusted replay-resistant freshness evidence; non-bool freshness/conflict fails closed.
On authority conflict, an exact trusted authority decision/snapshot is enforced or the controller fails closed; merely suppressing secretary and falling back to caller kwargs is forbidden.
current_gear derives from canonical monotonic runtime/shift state; caller state cannot weaken hysteresis or anti-thrash.
C_VERIFIED and other verification stages derive from exact trusted verifier/acceptance evidence with scope/freshness/revocation binding.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent verifier identity/receipt and one durable monotonic accepted-event path.
Same evidence/new ID, same ID/new binding, restart, rollback and polling replay cannot add credit.
select_gear_v2_1 consumes accepted-event receipts; receipt-less calls emit zero verified and operational credit.
DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only; heartbeat/poll/retry/wait/scheduler wake/window age remain zero Experience.
recent_shift_rate_ratio derives from canonical shift history with precommitted support/window/release semantics; anti-thrash has bounded recovery and paired non-regression.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and anti-self-reinforcement tested.
5/4/3 credit weights remain TEST_REQUIRED heuristics and are prohibited as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality or promotion thresholds.

Any speedup claim uses a preregistered paired matched baseline on durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with verification/risk non-regression; commit count and awake time are excluded.
All v1 tests and preserved verified baseline remain non-regressed; v2.1 candidate failure invalidates only affected candidate claims.
